name: dialog_choose_none
about: Harness self-test: a `dialog_choose` with no open dialogue session is reported as an action the harness could not run, never passed silently. Nothing opens a conversation; the pick at t=1.0 finds none. Under `expect_fail` the refusal is the failure the record expects (section `script`), so the run passes; without `expect_fail` the same record ends `error`. Reported as `fail`, it means the action ran with no session and its own trace line then met the expectation.
